1.o: يواجه رئيس الوزراء "مايكل كالو" مشكلة مروعة عندما تتعرض الأميرة "سوزانا"، أحد الأفراد المحبوبين في العائلة المالكة، للاختطاف.

2.o: بعد أن فشلت في التأثير على الحكام خلال مسابقة غناء، يجب على الفتاة أن تقوم بأعمال مهينة، أو تعود إلى حياة أشبه بالعبودية.

3.o: في المستقبل القريب، سيحصل كل فرد على شريحة ذاكرة تقوم بتسجيل كل ما يفعله وكل ما يراه ويسمعه.

1.o: بعد أن عرفت أن ثمة خدمة جديدة تتيح للأشخاص التواصل مع الموتى، تتواصل "مارثا"، الوحيدة والحزينة، مجددًا مع حبيبها الراحل.

2.o: تستيقظ "فيكتوريا" من النوم ولا تستطيع أن تتذكر شيئًا عن حياتها ويرفض أي شخص تقابله أن يتعامل معها.

3.o: يجد الممثل الكوميدي الفاشل، مقدم شخصية الدب الكرتوني المشهور "والدو"، نفسه منغمسًا في السياسة عندما أراد مدراء التلفزيون ترشيحه للرئاسة.

4.o: ثلاث قصص متداخلة عن تكنولوجيا مدمرة خلال فترة عيد الميلاد، يرويها رجلان في موقع ناءٍ في البرية المجمدة.

1.o: عندما تحاول امرأة جاهدة تعزيز تقييمها على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، يحالفها الحظ فتُدعى إلى حفل زفاف أنيق. لكن الأمور لا تسير كما هو مخطط.

2.o: يسجّل سائح أمريكي تنقصه الأموال مشاركته في اختبار نظام لعب ثوري جديد... لكنه يكتشف أن الإثارة حقيقية أكثر مما كان يتخيل.

3.o: بعد إصابة حاسوبه المحمول بالفيروسات، يواجه أحد المراهقين خيارًا صعبًا: إما تنفيذ أوامر تصله بالرسائل النصية أو إفشاء أدق أسراره الشخصية.

4.o: في إحدى المدن الساحلية عام 1987، تنشأ علاقة قوية تتحدى قوانين الزمان والمكان بين امرأة شابة خجولة وفتاة أخرى متحررة.

5.o: بعد معركته الأولى مع عدو مراوغ، يبدأ جندي في الإحساس بمشاعر غير مألوفة بالنسبة له وخلل تقني غريب.

6.o: إثر وفاة صحفية وسط عاصفة على وسائل التواصل الاجتماعي، تتوصل محققة مخضرمة ومساعدتها البارعة في الأمور التقنية إلى اكتشاف تقشعر له الأبدان.

1.o: يشرف القبطان "روبرت دايلي" على طاقمه بالحكمة والبسالة، لكن سرعان ما يكتشف مجنّد جديد أن لا شيء على هذه السفينة كما يبدو عليه.

2.o: مدفوعةً بقلقها على سلامة ابنتها، ترسل الأم العزباء "ماري" طلبًا للحصول على أحدث جهاز تكنولوجي يراقب أماكن تواجد ابنتها... والمزيد.

3.o: تهرع المهندسة المعمارية "ميا" لإخفاء سرّ مظلم وخطير، بينما تحصد محققة التأمين "شازيا" ذاكرة الأشخاص حول مسرح حادث وقع بالقرب منهم.

4.o: بعدما جمع بينهما برنامج للمواعدة الغرامية يقوم بوضع تاريخ انتهاء لكل العلاقات... سرعان ما يبدأ "فرانك" و"آيمي" في التشكيك في منطق النظام.

5.o: في مستودع مهجور، يقابل النابشون الذين يبحثون عن المؤن عدوًا شرسًا ويلوذون بالفرار عبر أرض قفر جرداء.

6.o: يعثر مسافرة بالصدفة على متحف يقع على طريق سريع مغبّر يحوي قطعًا أثرية نادرة تخص ثلة من المجرمين... وعامل جذب رئيسي مرعب.

1.o: يتواصل صديقا الكلّية السابقان "داني" و"كارل" عبر نسخة الواقع الافتراضي من لعبتهما المفضّلة، وتسفر جلسات اللعب الليلي عن مفاجآت. فما عواقبها؟

2.o: يشعل سائق سيارة أجرة في لندن أزمة دوليّة عندما يخطف عاملًا من شركة متخصصة بوسائل التواصل الاجتماعي. فهل تسعفهم خبرتهم في التواصل معه؟

3.o: تصبح مراهقة تشعر بالوحدة مهووسة بدمية آليّة تمثّل نجمتها الشهيرة "آشلي أوه"... وعلى الطرف الآخر، تبدأ حياة "آشلي" الحقيقيّة الهشّة بالتكشف.

1.o: تكتشف امرأة بسيطة أن إحدى خدمات البث العالمية قد اقتبست كل تفاصيل حياتها اليومية، بما في ذلك أسرارها، في عمل درامي من بطولة نجمة التمثيل القديرة "سلمى حايك".

2.o: أثناء العمل على تصوير فيلم وثائقي عن الطبيعة في بلدة أسكتلندية هادئة، يكتشف زوجان شابان أمرًا عن قصة محلية مثيرة ومرتبطة بأحداث سابقة مروعة.

3.o: في عالم بديل من عام 1969، يواجه رائدا فضاء تداعيات كارثة مُبهمة على الأرض أثناء رحلتهما في مهمة فضائية خطيرة وعالية التقنية.

4.o: تبذل نجمة هوليوود صاعدة، تُعاني من الاضطراب، أقصى جهدها للهروب من حشود مصوّري الفضائح المنتشرة، بينما تتعامل مع تداعيات حادث اصطدام وهروب.

5.o: تكتشف مساعدة مبيعات لطيفة في شمال إنجلترا عام 1979، أنها مُجبَرة على ارتكاب أعمال مروّعة لتجنب وقوع كارثة وشيكة.

1.o: حين تضطر معلمة للصراع من أجل حياتها، يقوم زوجها الشغوف بتسجيلها في نظام عالي التقنية يبقيها على قيد الحياة... ولكن الثمن سيكون باهظًا.

2.o: يساور امرأة شابة القلق حين ينضم أحد معارفها القدامى إلى الشركة التي تعمل فيها... خاصة وأن ثمة شيئًا غريبًا عنها لا يمكن لأحد رؤيته سواها.

3.o: نسخة جديدة عالية التقنية لفيلم كلاسيكي، تذهب فيها نجمة العمل إلى بُعد آخر، حيث يجب عليها الالتزام بما هو مخطط لضمان عودتها إلى عالمها.

4.o: في المستقبل القريب في لندن، يرتبط مشتبه به في جريمة قتل غريبة الأطوار بلعبة فيديو غير عادية تعود إلى حقبة التسعينيات... تتضمن مجتمعًا من أنماط الحياة الرقمية.

5.o: يتعامل رجل منعزل مع نظام رائد يسمح للمستخدمين بالدخول إلى الصور القديمة... مما يثير لديه مشاعر قوية خلال تلك التجربة.

6.ar: سفينة يو إس إس كاليستر - الدخول إلى إنفينيتي
6.o: تتقطع السبل بـ"نانيت كول" وطاقم سفينة "يو إس إس كاليستر" في عالم افتراضي لا نهائي، فيقاتلون للنجاة بحياتهم ضد 30 مليون لاعب.

1.o: A beautiful, naked amnesiac is found in Times Square covered in mysterious tattoos, including one bearing the name of FBI Agent Kurt Weller. Special Agent Weller and his FBI team must decode the map of clues on Jane Doe's body in order to thwart a deadly terrorist attack. Who is Jane Doe - is she an asset or enemy? Who wiped her memory? And who is behind the tattoos?

2.o: The team unlocks a cryptic tattoo that points to Major Arthur Gibson, an Air Force pilot with a painful past and a lethal agenda. Jane continues to search for clues to her identity and is haunted when flashes of a disturbing memory force her to question her past. Meanwhile, Weller thinks he might know Jane's true identity.

3.o: An infamous crew of thieves almost pulls off the perfect jewel heist, except one thief - with a Navy SEAL tattoo identical to Jane's - is captured at the scene of the crime. Does this man know Jane? Meanwhile, Jane receives a visit - and an ambiguous warning - from the mysterious bearded man from her first memory as Weller and Mayfair struggle with Jane's role on the team.

4.o: Patterson and her puzzle-expert boyfriend, David, decode a tattoo clue that sends the team to the Centers for Disease Control (CDC). While at the CDC, the team discovers a hidden message on Jane's body that uncovers a plot that could have catastrophic global consequences. Meanwhile, Jane and Weller grow closer.

5.o: After a seemingly straightforward hostage situation turns out to have deeper international implications, the CIA and FBI find themselves racing against each other to apprehend the same criminal with a dark history. Carter expresses concern about Jane's trustworthiness, causing friction with Mayfair and testing Reade's loyalty to the team. Meeting Weller's family proves overwhelming for Jane as she grapples with her identity.

6.o: When an assassination leads the team to a dangerous app that allows criminals to track government vehicles, they have to work with the app's surprising creator to take it down. Jane and Weller attempt to keep their relationship professional. Zapata struggles with a moral issue.

7.o: One of Jane's tattoos sends the team to a remote location where they find themselves face to face with a dangerous criminal in a case that puts Jane and Weller's strained relationship to the test and threatens to expose Mayfair's secrets. Meanwhile, Patterson breaks the rules to solve a tattoo puzzle.

8.o: After a police officer is murdered, Patterson unlocks a disturbing tattoo that appears to have predicted his killing, and the team chases a violent clue trail to stop further attacks. Mayfair reveals secrets from her past to Weller, seriously testing their relationship.

9.o: Jane and Weller go undercover as a world-class assassin couple to prevent deadly information from getting into the wrong hands. The intimate assignment draws them closer than ever. Meanwhile, David embarks on a solo mission to win Patterson back, and Carter clashes with Mayfair over how to handle a dangerous individual.

10.o: In the thrilling mid-season finale the team goes after a group of sleeper spies that have just been activated and race to stop a slew of assassinations.

11.o: Jane reels from a series of massive revelations about her tattoos and grapples with whether to trust Oscar. Meanwhile, a tattoo leads the team to a shocking discovery in the Black Sea.

12.o: After a disturbed Iraq War vet shoots up a military base, the team exposes a sinister plot. As Jane and Weller race to stop a single-minded scientist, Jane recalls her own mysterious military past and contemplates a new relationship with Oscar.

13.o: After a tip reveals there's a mole within the FBI's New York Office, the team must hunt for the operative while facing extreme scrutiny from Inspector Fischer. The team's deepest secrets threaten to be exposed, and everyone is a potential suspect - but some, especially Jane Doe have more to hide.

14.o: An anonymous tip leads the team to investigate an urgent death row case,  ultimately sending Zapata undercover. After nearly  getting caught during the mole hunt, Jane considers  leaving the FBI.

15.o: After a painting featuring one of Jane's tattoos is heisted from a gallery, the team discovers Jane is the real target. In order to protect her team, Jane goes AWOL.

16.o: After an armored truck is robbed, the team discovers that the stolen goods are chemical weapons and they must race to thwart a terrorist plot. Meanwhile, Jane  grapples with a confusing memory of Weller - while growing even closer to Oscar. Meanwhile Patterson receives a phone call from someone from her past.

17.o: After Patterson discovers a hidden message in the New York Times crossword, she embarks on a tattoo scavenger hunt that leads her into danger. Oscar finally tells Jane more about who she was, and Weller seeks his Dad's opinion about who kidnapped Taylor Shaw.

18.o: In order to capture a dangerous international criminal, Jane and Weller are forced to collaborate with the only person he will meet: their former target, Rich DotCom. Jane must decide whether to risk hurting Weller by executing a morally questionable order from Oscar.

19.o: When a school shooting breaks out during the investigation of a tattoo, the team splits up to take down the shooter. Mayfair copes with some issues from her past.

20.o: When a mysterious young girl with a tattoo connection falls into Borden's care, he brings her case to the FBI team -- but her ties to a terrorist organization prove dangerous for all of them. Meanwhile, a conflicted Jane starts to grow close to Weller again, and friendship blossoms between Borden and Patterson.

21.o: The FBI is locked down when criminal hackers infiltrate the building, trapping the team inside SIOC. As they fight their way out, the close quarters force Mayfair, Zapata, Reade, and Sarah to confront personal conflicts.

22.t: If Love a Rebel, Death Will Render
22.o: After an abandoned baby is found with a tattoo identical to one of Jane's, the team races to piece together the child's identity and save dozens of infants. A furious Jane confronts Oscar about the outcome of his secret missions.

23.o: Weller searches for the truth within a heartbreaking and confounding assertion. Jane reaches out to a former suspect for help with Oscar. Meanwhile, the rest of the team struggles to help a friend...

1.o: After escaping from CIA custody, the team recaptures Jane and convinces her to become a triple-agent within her old  terrorist organization where she unlocks some major secrets from her  past, while recent betrayals from both sides threaten to tear her and  the team apart for good.

2.o: The team races to stop a corrupt DEA agent from selling stinger missiles  to a drug cartel as Weller fights to keep everyone  together under the increasing pressures of Jane's rift with the others and the uncomfortable addition of Nas as co-leader.

3.o: Weller and the team must race the clock to stop a  series of escalating New York City bombings, while Jane is forced to go on an assassination mission to prove her  loyalty... or suffer the consequences.

4.o: Nas and Weller navigate their new dynamic as co-leaders during the team's hunt for a museum gala assassin, who turns out turns out to be harboring a dark secret. Jane starts to see a softer side of her old organization.

5.o: After a prominent politician is almost killed during a rally, Weller and the team must work with U.S. Marshal Allie Knight to take down a mob leader.

6.o: While Weller and Nas chase a fugitive whistleblower in Bulgaria, Jane goes on a Sandstorm mission with Roman. Reade and Zapata must deal with an urgent matter.

7.o: Rich Dotcom returns to the FBI when he needs help with a pressing issue.

8.t: We Fight Deaths on Thick Lone Waters
8.o: When Weller and Jane go missing during an undercover operation, the rest of the team must interrogate two criminals who hold the key to finding them. AUSA Weitz returns with a vendetta against the team.

9.o: After Jane discovers that Sandstorm is gearing up for an imminent attack, she risks everything to send a secret SOS to her FBI team.

10.t: Nor I, Nigel, AKA Leg in Iron
10.o: Patterson is missing... and a newly amnesiac Roman is on the loose. Jane and Weller must race Shepherd – and the clock – to find them before it's too late.

11.o: After one of the world's most-wanted terrorists surfaces in New York for unknown reasons, the team must partner with the CIA to stop a deadly bombing.

12.o: When an unusual tattoo leads back to Roman, the team must decide whether to send him into the field...to go undercover with a dangerous biker gang.

13.o: The team gets a major break in the Sandstorm case when they discover Shepherd's true identity...   and a decades-old connection between her and Weller.

14.o: A tattoo points the team toward a powerful collegiate secret society, but they can't infiltrate it without the help of one of its alumni...Rich Dotcom.

15.t: Draw O Caesar, Erase a Coward
15.o: After a set of tattoos produces multiple leads, the team divides into unlikely pairings to chase down a deadly underworld courier.

16.t: Evil Did I Dwell, Lewd I Did Live
16.o: With Nas's help, Weller and Jane finally come face-to-face with Nas's inside source within Sandstorm, and square off with an old foe.

17.o: Jane and her new flame Oliver find themselves in a dangerous situation that exposes the secrets they've both been keeping.  Uncertain if they can trust each other, the couple must stay alive while Weller and the team race to save them.

18.o: Under investigation by an old rival, the team struggles to defend itself. Meanwhile, a tattoo leads them to a mysterious death at a foster home

19.o: Jane and Weller go undercover on a high-stakes scavenger hunt run by powerful hackers. Shepherd journeys to Thailand to procure a dangerous weapon.

20.o: Zapata's transgressions catch up to her, sending her to jail alongside a potentially powerful Sandstorm asset named Devon. Weller and the team must go to exceptional lengths to help Zapata out.

21.o: The team finally cracks a member of Sandstorm, leading to a huge breakthrough in uncovering Phase Two.

22.o: As the FBI copes with a tragedy, Weller finds himself at the center of a surprising event. Jane faces an uncertain future.

1.o: 18 months after parting ways under mysterious circumstances, the FBI team is brought back together by a new crisis.

2.o: As the team adjusts to their new dynamic -- and the new tattoos -- they battle a dangerous foreign power that is trying to hijack a satellite.

3.o: While Jane and Weller hunt down a collective of dangerous computer hackers, Patterson and Rich Dot Com must work together to hide an explosive secret from their past.

4.o: As the team chases a deadly bomber who's terrorizing Manhattan, Jane uncovers a shattering secret from her youth.

5.o: While Jane struggles to cope with a secret from her past, the team races to prevent an international crisis.

6.o: The team goes undercover on a movie set to stop a terrorist plot with unlikely backers. Roman blackmails Weller with a horrible secret about Jane.

7.o: Facing a threat within the FBI, the team is forced to run a covert operation out of Jane and Weller's apartment. A tattoo leads to a doctor with a deadly secret.

8.o: As the team works together to take down a foe, Jane and Weller face a toxic secret that threatens to tear them apart.

9.o: After some personal strife, the team must find a way to work together to track down missing nuclear warheads.

10.o: The team races to thwart a deadly terrorist plot with the help of Reade's journalist girlfriend.

11.o: While Jane and Weller partner with a mysterious man from Jane's past to find a missing person, the team races to stop an arms deal.

12.o: Weller and his former FBI partner reunite for a dangerous undercover mission while Zapata interrogates a past foe.

13.o: A surprising visit from Nas leads the team to investigate a dangerous piece of technology that was stolen from the NSA. Roman and Blake  grow closer as they attend a high-stakes poker game.

14.o: When Patterson's investigation into a tattoo results in a horrible incident, she tries to figure out what went wrong - but quickly realizes all is not as it seems.

15.o: The team must decide whether to trust a prisoner who warns them of a dangerous plot. Zapata is caught between the FBI and the CIA. Roman and Crawford butt heads over how to handle a volatile situation.

16.o: A CIA source threatens to tear the team apart. Rich's place in the FBI is called into question. Roman and Crawford spend a day together under strange circumstances.

17.o: The FBI team and Avery attend a gala hosted by their target Hank Crawford in hopes of arresting him. Roman grows closer to the Crawfords.

18.o: Jane and her team must fight for their lives when Roman sends deadly assassins after them. Meanwhile, Patterson goes on a date, Reade contends with the O.P.R. inquisitor, Jane and Weller go to dinner, and Zapata attends a funeral.

19.o: The team must partner with an oddball conspiracy theorist to keep Crawford from acquiring a deadly weapon. Meanwhile, Roman struggles to maintain his personal life with Blake while completing a series of secret missions.

20.o: After receiving shocking news about Avery's father, Jane and Weller must hunt down an elusive criminal. Meanwhile, Patterson's father helps the team in the lab.

21.o: Jane is forced to recruit someone from her past to help take down a dangerous alliance.

22.o: Jane and Weller hunt Roman back to where it all started and attempt to stop him.

1.o: The FBI team hunts a dangerous enemy operative, and a deadly new foe emerges.

2.o: The entire intelligence community is put in jeopardy when Remi co-opts an FBI case.

3.o: Patterson and Rich DotCom take the reigns as the FBI team faces an explosive threat.

4.o: A decoded tattoo leads the team to a mysterious cache of dolls which turn out to be vehicles for biological weapons being sent around the world and now to the FBI. Jane exploits the fear of the weapons to advance her own plan to recover Shepherd.

5.o: A blast from Rich DotCom's past sends the FBI team after a deadly terrorist plot.

6.o: The team is drawn into dangerous political intrigue when a tattoo points to someone from Weitz's past.

7.t: Case: Sun, Moon, and the Truth
7.o: Remi's schemes put her and Weller in danger, while Patterson and Rich solve a mysterious puzzle at the FBI.

8.o: Remi races against the ever-worsening ZIP poisoning to enact her ultimate plan.

9.o: The team's desperate gambit to get Jane back puts her head-to-head with Remi.

10.o: Reade confronts Zapata, while the team follows a lead to a potential cure for Jane.

11.o: The murder of a best-selling true crime novelist sends Jane and the team on a hunt for a serial killer detailed in the author's final manuscript, which also features lightly fictionalized versions of the FBI team.

12.t: The Tale of the Book of Secrets
12.o: Roman's clues lead to a billionaire hypochondriac with stem cells that could cure Jane, who is now on her deathbed. Patterson and Rich offer to trade the Book of Secrets for the stem cells -- but first they'll have to get it.

13.t: Though This Be Madness, Yet There Is Method In't
13.o: Jane and Weller's romantic getaway is cut short when the team must stop Madeline Burke's plans to blow up a building and crash a plane that turns out to be more than the average commercial airliner.

14.t: The Big Blast from the Past Episode
14.o: An active bomber forces the team to delve into a case from their past.

15.o: Jane's past with Shepherd and Sandstorm both helps and hurts the team's efforts to stop the sale of a device that will weaponize stolen plutonium.

16.t: The One Where Jane Visits an Old Friend
16.o: Madeline escalates her plan, but the team isn't the only one chasing her down. Rich grows concerned for Boston’s well-being, and Jane seeks help from a familiar enemy.

17.t: The Night of the Dying Breath
17.o: The team races against the clock to save one of their own after Dominic enacts a nightmarish scheme in a bid for Madeline’s freedom. Tensions soar with Madeline as she makes her own demands.

18.o: Patterson's father, Bill Nye, returns for a case that pits the team against a pestiferous foe. Zapata goes rogue with an old friend. Jane and Weller continue their search for the hooded figure.

19.o: The team discovers an international conspiracy when a deadly weapon is stolen, Jane supports Weller when someone from his past dredges up painful memories, and Patterson and Rich contend with their newly released hacker accomplice.

20.o: A horrifying and vengeful villain threatens the FBI. Weller considers his priorities. Zapata and Reade try to navigate their living situation. Patterson explores a budding interest.

21.o: Dominic begins to enact Madeline's cataclysmic scheme as the team rushes to stop him. Tensions rise as past secrets begin to unravel.

22.o: The team sets out on an international mission to stop an attack from spreading. Madeline attempts to turn the tables as internal conflict threatens relationships within the team.

1.o: Jane tries to pick up the pieces after the explosive finale in Iceland. She gets a strange message from an unknown ally that allows her to mount a rescue mission to free Rich Dotcom from a CIA black-site... but she'll need the help from her old rival Sho Akhtar.

2.o: Jane and the team reach out to Patterson's father in the hope of gaining access to a high-level conference in Finland where they hope to bring Matthew Weitz to their side.

3.o: When an op goes bad, the team must deal with a proverbial monster in their house before it can take them down one by one. Meanwhile, Director Weitz is forced into a tense game of psychological chess as Madeline Burke attempts to assess his loyalty and root out a potential mole at the FBI.

4.o: In order to stop a terrorist group from procuring a deadly chemical weapon, the team must remember key details from their first days at the FBI. Meanwhile, Weller worries after he gets scary news about the health of his daughter.

5.o: When Jane is shot and Weller is kidnapped, the team must fight to save both of their lives while maintaining the secrecy of their hidden base. Meanwhile, Weller is haunted by some dark ghosts from the past.

6.o: When Ice Cream, the Icelandic fixer, returns to collect his debt, the team is forced into a life and death race around the world to solve a series of puzzles and recover the infamous stolen Gardner paintings.

7.o: In an effort to stop Madeline from shipping two planes full of ZIP to the US, the team splits up into a high-stakes undercover mission where they intercept Madeline's son. Meanwhile, Madeline interrogates an old ally to get information on Kurt and the team.

8.o: The team scrambles to get ahead of Madeline and Ivy as they close in on the bunker's location, but someone on the inside is feeding Madeline information. As her plan takes shape, the team may be forced to take desperate measures.

9.o: With the surviving members of the team captured and held in FBI custody, Madeline and Ivy are in the final stages of their plan, but a few unlikely allies come out from the woodwork, trying to stop her before it's too late.

10.t: Love You to Bits and Bytes
10.o: As Ivy races to retrieve the devastating stash of ZIP bombs, the remaining members of the team must rely on the help of a longtime thorn in their side, the very unstable genius Kathy Gustafson.

11.o: Turn off your mind, relax and float down stream...it is not dying...it is not dying.

1.o: Ten years on from disappearing without trace, a politician's son returns causing repercussions through their family and the local community.

2.o: Hank meets Adam. Danny reveals his suspicions about Adam to Bridey. Nina feels haunted by her past.

3.o: Gabe Clements lets Nina know how he would like to deal with the investigation. Adam goes back to the bunker to see if it can help him to remember anything. Claire's motives end up being questioned.

Though the Knights know their journey to the Isle of the Blessed is fraught with danger, none could anticipate the sacrifice Arthur intends to make there.

Will anyone notice Merlin's unusual behaviour before he is able to do any serious harm to the King?

Far from home and with no-one to trust, Merlin becomes embroiled in a deadly game of cat and mouse. No longer sure who is the hunter and who is the hunted, can the young warlock survive long enough to uncover the truth?

When Sir Lancelot returns from the dead, old feelings reignite, as the drama continues. Gwen must fight temptation before she commits an unspeakable act of betrayal; one that would destroy the legacy of Camelot forever.

With heads and hearts thrown into turmoil, Merlin becomes suspicious. Can a man really defy death, or is there something more sinister at play?

Trapped in Ealdor with a ruthless army closing in, their situation becomes desperate. Arthur must take control before Camelot is lost forever… But faced with Agravaine’s betrayal and the strength of Morgana’s force, the young King has lost his conviction. Only Merlin can restore his faith, and only an extraordinary act can prove to the King that he was born to rule. Will the young warlock convince Arthur before his dreams of Albion fall to pieces?

King Arthur and his knights undertake a dangerous mission into the unknown in search of answers - but once there, Merlin finds himself locked in a battle unlike any he has fought before.

What game is Mordred playing? And what powerful secrets are Morgana and the druid Ruadan (Liam Cunningham) searching for amongst its twisted catacombs? It seems like this time, not even Merlin can stop Arthur from walking right into the lion's den… For in this bleak and transient wilderness, only one thing is certain: the great trial for Albion has finally begun.

Unable to resist temptation, he seizes the chance to speak to the person he misses most – his father, Uther Pendragon. But the spirit world is a dark and dangerous place, for little does Arthur realize that his decision comes at a terrible price. Against all odds, Merlin must put right Arthur's mistake before Camelot, and everything they have built, is destroyed forever.

But despite Merlin’s warnings, headstrong Arthur refuses to take the words of the Disir seriously and their fury rains down on Camelot. Only the greatest sacrifice can appease them, and with the kingdom in jeopardy, is it one that Arthur is prepared to make?

Faced with the King’s uncertainty, Merlin has just one chance to save him from his destiny, but this decision comes at the highest price.

But when stable hand Tyr Seward becomes caught in the crossfire, he threatens to ruin everything… As the plot thickens and reaches its deadly climax, can a suspicious Merlin unravel the truth before it’s too late?

When Merlin agrees to help a young Druid boy, he has no choice but to leave Camelot on a dangerous mission.

And with the citadel distracted by the visit of the fearsome Sarrum of Amata, it seems that no one will notice his absence.

But as the sky darkens, so do Merlin's suspicions - is there more to Daegal than meets the eye? And can a man as ruthless as the Sarrum ever really be trusted? Too late, the young warlock realises he's made a terrible mistake.

9.o:
Merlin knows he must act fast before Morgana’s twisted control over Gwen gets further out of hand.

But only the most powerful magic can save the Queen and this will not be easy, even for Merlin. As the High Priestess tightens her grip on Camelot, one thing is clear - she will not give up her puppet without a fight.

10.o: Morgana leads a terrifying manhunt in pursuit of her old foe Alator of the Catha, for she knows without doubt that he can tell her exactly where to find Emrys. Merlin's life is in severe danger, so when the mysterious Finna offers to help him, is he right to trust her?

11.o:
Mordred finds himself torn between loyalty and love, but little does he realise that the path he chooses will shape Camelot's destiny.

As the drums of war beat ever louder, a desperate Merlin feels trapped by the cruel circle of fate - is he powerless to stop his dreams of Albion from crumbling to dust?

12.o:
High in the mountains, a great horde gathers; Morgana prepares for war with a vengeful Mordred at her side.

Merlin feels the weight of his destiny like never before as the ancient prophecies play out with terrifying accuracy. But before he can save his beloved Camelot, he must save himself. For it is not just the kingdom Morgana wishes to destroy – it is also Emrys.

13.o: And so it seems the Prophets did not lie. As the great battle rages on Camlann's mighty plain, Merlin faces his moment of destiny. Can he find the strength to save the man he made a King; the Camelot they fought to build; and the brotherhood they shared?

1.o: يقرر عبده إقامة حفل عيد ميلاد عفاف ويدعو كل أبنائه، يزور زميل سابق لعبده ماجد بالمشفى مما يثير غضبه، يتشاجر عبده بالخطأ مع رفعت مدير الشركة الجديد، يحزن عبده لعدم مجيء ماجد الحفل ويتعذر بمرض زوجته سوزي، يطلب محمود من عاطف الزواج بعفاف، يطلب عاطف من عبده ترك وظيفته.

2.o: يتفق رفعت مع فتحي على إيقاع عبده بالمشاكل تنقل صفاء لقسم آخر مما يثير غضب عبده، يقبل عبده طلب محمود بالزواج من عفاف، يرفض ماجد ورأفت زواج عفاف من محمود بسبب عمله في تصليح السيارات مما يثير الشجار بينهما.

3.o: يصدم عبده لقرار ماجد بمقاطعته في حالة زواج عفاف بمحمود، تنصح صفاء عبده بالوقوف بوجه أبنائه، يقرر عبده تزويج عفاف ومحمود دون علم ابنائه ودون حضوره، تحاول إيناس إقناع ماجد بقبول الزواج ولكنه يهينها.

4.o: تفشل عفاف في إقناع رأفت بقبول زواجها، تدافع صفاء عن عبده لدى رفعت بعد خطأه بالعمل، يهنيء عاطف عفاف بالزواج دون حضوره، يحضر عبده الزفاف، تُفشل صفاء ماجد ورأفت في إفساد الزفاف، يزور رأفت بعد الزفاف لكي لا يشعر بالوحدة.

5.o: يزور عاطف بيت عفاف لتهنئتها، يخبر عبده عبدالفضيل برغبة رفعت في تزوير ملفات مالية للشركة للتهرب من الضرائب، تغلق ورشة محمود بسبب رأفت، يزور عبده إيناس أثناء سفر عاطف، يقنع رأفت ماجد بتراجعه عن مقاطعته لعبده ويزوره بمنزله.

6.o: يتوفى عبدالفضيل ويسرق رفعت ملف المستخلصات من مكتب عبده، يُفصل عبده من العمل بحجة صعوبة مواكبته للأساليب الحديثة بالعمل، يلجأ عبده لأبنائه لمساعدته في رفع قضية على رفعت ولكنهم يتهربون من مساعدته.

7.o: يصاب عبده بإنهيار عصبي بسبب فصله من العمل وتظل عفاف وصفاء بجواره، يعرض عبده على طبيب فيطلب منهم إدخاله مصحة نفسية، يتجمع عاطف وماجد ورأفت لإيجاد بديل لعلاج عبده.

8.o: يتقرر مبيت عبده بمنزل رأفت، تسرق صفاء الملف من الشركة، يتضح حمل عفاف، يفوق عبده من الصدمة النفسية ويقرر الذهاب لدار مسنين دون إخبار أولاده ولكن يعيده ابنائه لمنزله.

9.o: تبدأ المشاكل في الظهور بين بدرية ورأفت بسبب مبيت عبده بمنزلهما وتدخله في شؤونهما، تحضر صفاء الملف لعبده لكي يتابع قضية فصله، يبدأ رأفت في التقرب من صفاء.

10.o: تعامل بدرية عبده معاملة جافة، يرفع عبده قضية على رفعت الذي يفشل في مساومته، يتورط عبده وصفاء بعملهما مع مهرب أدوية فاسدة دون علمهما.

11.o: يتسبب عبده في مشاكل بعمل رأفت، ينتقل عبده للمبيت بمنزل عاطف، يقرر رفعت حرق المباني التي يتم التحقيق حولها.

12.o: يتم التحقيق مع عبده وفتحي بشأن الحريق، يسعد عبده بمكوثه لدى عاطف ولكن تحدث مشكلة بينه وبين عاطف وسرعان ما يعود عاطف لمصالحته.

13.o: يتقرر سفر إيناس للخارج فتطلب سوزي من عبده المبيت بمنزلها وماجد، يتدخل عبده في حياة ماجد بعد تذمر سوزي من إهماله لها مما يتسبب في شجارهما، يطلب الشاب مدحت الزواج من صفاء.

14.o: تفتتح سوزي بمساعدة عبده مشغل للملابس بالفيلا ويتشاجر معها ماجد بسبب ذلك ويرفضه ويقيم حفل بالفيلا لتخبر ضيوفه بغلقها للمشغل، يتشاجر عبده مع الضيوف بعد إهانتهم لسوزي ويقرر ماجد إيداع عبده بمصحة نفسية، يتفق رفعت وفتحي مع خضير ليعترف بحرقه للمبنى ولكنه يسجل لهم اعترافاتهم.

15.o: يذهب عبده للمبيت بمنزل عفاف، يسجن كلًا من فتحي ورفعت، يجري ماجد عملية لمريض رغم تعبه ويتوفى المريض، يُفضح سرقة رأفت لمقالات مترجمة ويتشاجر مع بدرية بسبب أنانيتها ويترك منزله، تنقل عفاف للمشفى.

16.o: تنجب عفاف صبي وتتجمع الأسرة للإحتفال، يستدعى ماجد للتحقيق معه من قبل الشرطة وتوجه له جُنحة بالقتل الخطأ، يكلف له عبده محامي، تقرر إيناس العودة لمصر.

17.o: يتعرض رأفت لأزمة مالية، يصدر قرار بوقف ماجد عن العمل، يواجه عبده ابنائه الثلاثة بأخطائهم ويطردهم من منزله ليعتمدوا على أنفسهم، يتصالح كل من ابنائه مع زوجاتهم، وتمر مدة زمنية وتتجمع العائلة للإحتفال بعيد ميلاد عفاف بينما تسود الفرحة بين العائلة.

1.o:
Special Agent Scott Forrester and his Budapest-based FBI fly team head to Croatia, after Isobel Castille enlists their help to capture an American fugitive who escaped to Zagreb with a 14-year-old girl. OA continues with the mission overseas, intent on bringing the fugitive to justice, while Europol agent Katrin Jaeger attempts to help the team secure the necessary support and access from the less-than-cooperative local authorities.

The crossover starts on FBI S04E01 All That Glitters (I) and FBI: Most Wanted S03E01 Exposed (II).

2.o: The International Fly Team is called on when a young mother flees to Hungary with her son, after losing partial custody of her son in the U.S. However, after the boy is kidnapped from his mother in broad daylight in Budapest, the team questions which parent is the danger in the child’s life

3.o: The team investigates when the hijacking of millions worth of cryptocurrency en route to a safety vault in Switzerland leaves an American transporter dead and another on the run.

4.o: The team investigates an American citizen who is proclaiming his innocence after seeking sanctuary at Madrid’s U.S. embassy while still covered in the blood of his murdered Spanish boyfriend. Also, Vo and Raines continue to grow their friendship.

5.o: The team investigates an American journalist’s death by poison after his attempt to meet with an anonymous source in Poland. Also, Kellett takes Forrester to task for being overprotective with her during the mission.

6.o: After a U.S. intelligence negotiator goes missing and her ransacked Paris apartment is discovered to be covered in her blood, the team is on the clock to find her before the country's nuclear secrets fall into the wrong hands. Also, Forrester finds himself drawing certain parallels to his mother's disappearance.

7.o: When an American founder of an illegal adults-only site is killed in Prague, the team is tasked to locate his co-founder, who is still on the run in Czech Republic; Kellett struggles to maintain a relationship with her mother.

8.o: When a group of Americans are among the victims of a bombing at a festival in Budapest, the team is brought in to find the perpetrators before they strike again. Also, when Vo's new beau is injured in the blast, she re-evaluates what dating truly means while in the bureau.

9.o: The team jets to Bulgaria when terrorists hold hostage for millions in cryptocurrency a concert hall filled with multinational student performers and their families. Raines is intent on proving his field skills, and Forrester receives news of their dog, Tank.

10.o: Kellett and the team reluctantly join an investigation in Northern Ireland, when one of Kellett's informants is arrested for his connection to a robbery and murder, and calls her to help clear his name.

11.o: When an NYPD officer is detained in Transnistria for aggravated assault, the fly team investigates his claims of infiltrating a sex trafficking ring being concealed by those in power; Forrester receives an unusual message from an unknown sender.

12.o: When a notorious American tech tycoon becomes involved in a murder in Frankfurt, Germany, the team must chase him down amid the local protesters he's incited with his conspiracy theories on social media.

13.o: A couple flees to Albania while awaiting sentencing for bilking millions in COVID-19 relief funds from the U.S. government; Kellett works the case from Budapest as she and Forrester try to regain their professional boundaries.

14.o: The team must figure out how to keep the U.S. attorney general safe amid a possible security breach while she's in Hungary for an important meeting.

15.o: When Raines' sister goes missing in Kosovo, he goes rogue to find her, putting his job and his life on the line; Kellett and Forrester face further scrutiny from inside the bureau.

16.o: The Fly Team lands in hot water when Vo is found at the scene where a Hungarian gambling regulator was murdered.

17.o: When an American vintner is shot and killed on his wine estate in France, the team must determine if the region's local protest group with a history of violence against foreigners is to blame.

18.o: Following a frenzied attack by gunmen aboard an American-owned river cruise ship on the Danube, the Fly Team heads to Vienna to investigate why the boat was targeted. Also, Forrester realizes his feelings of mistrust caused by his past are affecting his personal relationships.

19.o: The Fly Team works to hunt down the sniper responsible for killing an American during an attack targeting a biomedical lab in Belgium. Also, Jaeger clashes with her boss at Europol over her allegiance to the Fly Team.

20.o: The Fly Team and Jaeger head to Berlin when the 19-year-old son of an American billionaire is found unresponsive in his apartment. As the team works to determine if foul play was involved, they realize there’s a shadowy group on the case as well.

21.o: When a private jet carrying American citizens is shot down outside of a small town in Poland, the Fly Team looks into the man who missed the flight. Also, Forrester is conflicted when he receives information from his mother.

1.o: The Fly Team and new Europol liaison Megan “Smitty” Garretson investigate when an American police detective on the Federal task force is murdered in Paris while looking into a U.S. company suspected of selling illegal weapons in France and the Middle East.

2.o: When a local predator begins extorting underage American girls online, the team attempts to bring the offender to justice with on-site help from one of the victims; Kellett decides she should find a roommate.

3.o: The team travels to Mallorca when an American is found brutally murdered on the estate of her powerful father-in-law.

4.o: When a former U.S. Marine is detained in Istanbul on a charge of smuggling antiquities, the Fly Team races against the clock to organize her release before the Turkish police learn the truth behind her visit

5.o: The Fly Team searches Bucharest for a Romanian surrogate who goes missing shortly before carrying the biological child of an American couple to term. Also, Forrester’s concern about the safety of his neighbors in Budapest intensifies.

6.o: Vo’s friend from the U.S. Navy calls in a favor to help find her missing nephew in Crete. Meanwhile, Forrester hangs back in Budapest to take care of personal business.

7.o: When an American businessman’s bodyguard and girlfriend are kidnapped a few feet away from him in Barcelona, the Fly Team questions if the man is as innocent as he claims. Also, Raines grows closer to Maya, the owner of the team’s favorite local bar.

8.o: Vo goes under cover when the team investigates the mysterious death of an American model in Milan; Kellett is caught off guard when Dandridge arrives looking for visibility on the case.

9.o: The team races through the streets of Budapest to put a halt to a major art heist about to be perpetrated by an American; Forrester grows angry as Dandridge watches every move the team makes.

10.o: When an American basketball player for a Lithuanian team goes into cardiac arrest, the team investigates along with Zoey McKenna, the new agent appointed by Dandridge.

11.o: The team races to find a kidnapped American teen in Austria as the clock ticks on Forrester's reassignment.

12.o: The Fly Team and Smitty reunite with Jaeger in Berlin as they all delve into a case involving an unidentified American who killed an elderly German man who appears to have been a covert asset of the ruthless Stasi in East Germany during the Cold War.

13.o: The team investigates the death of an American lawyer working out of Budapest, Hungary, after his is killed by a car bomb; Kellett begins to grow close to Hungarian lieutenant Benedek Erdős as the critical case progresses.

14.o: The team and Smitty head to Morocco when a commercial aircraft flying from New York to Athens is grounded and an American citizen on board goes missing; Kellett's relationship with Erdős continues to blossom.

15.o: The Fly Team lends a helping hand to the Hungarian National Police when one of their police officers is accused of murdering a couple in Budapest; Kellett questions her relationship with Erdős.

16.o:
When the abduction of an American architect in Rome appears to be connected to a brewing terror threat in New York City, FBI’s Jubal and Nina join Forrester and his Fly Team in Italy as they work together to find the missing American and shed light on the terrorists’ U.S. target.

The crossover continues on FBI S05E17 Imminent Threat (II) and FBI: Most Wanted S04E16 Imminent Threat (III).

17.o: The Fly Team heads to Vienna to find the culprit of an acid attack on a rising American prima ballerina. Also, Smitty receives some troubling intel from a familiar face.

18.o: The team jumps into action to protect Forrester when a Russian hit man seeks revenge on him; Raines is sent into a tailspin when someone close to him is taken.

19.o: After an American tourist is killed while visiting Stockholm with his girlfriend, the Fly Team must work together to take down a Swedish group responsible for the hate crime.

20.o: After a cybersecurity expert robs one of Switzerland's largest and most secretive banks, the Fly Team is called to track down the fugitive. Also, Smitty's loyalty is put to the test.

21.o: The Fly Team jets off to Portugal when the daughter of a prominent American hotelier becomes the primary suspect in the murder of an employee. Also, Raines becomes concerned about Vo.

22.o: When a Russian missile is stolen and put on the black market in Budapest, the Fly Team must secure the weapon before a mysterious American arms broker delivers it into the wrong hands.

1.o: The Fly Team, with the help of their new intel analyst, Special Agent Amanda Tate, works to clean up the pieces left behind after a massive explosion rocks headquarters and their key suspect slips away.

2.o: When an ex-FBI agent suddenly resurfaces in a brutal Tripoli prison, Forrester and Powell risk everything to go under cover as prisoners to break him out; the fly team adjusts to their new and improved HQ.

3.o: When an American family's lavish sweet sixteen celebration is cut short after the mother of the birthday girl is found dead near their European estate, the Fly Team heads to Monaco to find the woman's murderer. Vo begins seeing Raines in a new light.

4.o: The Fly Team heads to Bulgaria in search of a wanted criminal who is exploiting underage American girls. Meanwhile, Raines becomes curious when Forrester asks him to keep an eye on Powell.

5.o: When a disgraced former U.S. cabinet member is arrested in Vienna, the Fly Team is sent to investigate whether he and his assistant were peddling classified government documents. Powell struggles as he is forced to stay behind on desk duty.

6.o: The Fly Team is called in to investigate when an American college student is arrested at a hostel in Prague for showing aggression toward local police who were dismissive of her sexual abuse claims. Also, Vo makes use of her sexual assault advocacy experience from her army days as they work to ensure the victim gets justice.

7.o: The Fly Team heads to the Tuscan countryside after an American couple's son is kidnapped right outside their new home. Concerns are heightened as fingers begin to point to the mafia.

8.o: Assistant Special Agent in Charge Jubal Valentine heads to Budapest to personally help the Fly Team and the CIA take down the cartel that murdered his former girlfriend and colleague. As part of the mission, Forrester poses as an undercover arms expert.

9.o: When a U.S. mercenary claiming to fight child trafficking abroad is apprehended at a remote Romanian border police outpost after the U.S. DOJ suspects his crew of embezzlement, Tate and Raines attempt to get him to flip on the leader of the group. The mission takes a turn when the outpost is attacked as they work to secure evidence.

10.o: When a wild night in Amsterdam for three ex-Navy men ends with one found dead in his hotel room, the Fly Team must dive into the red-light district to hunt down his killer. Meanwhile, Tate finds herself in a bind with her ex over custody of their daughter.

11.o: When a former member of the Irish Republican Army turned U.S. citizen is shot while in London with his son touring youth football academies, Smitty and the Fly Team work to hunt down the people responsible as the group becomes increasingly violent. While in London, Smitty pays a visit to her mother who she believes can help the team locate an old family friend who may have a connection to the case.

12.o: When the owner of a prominent cyber security company is murdered in Copenhagen, mass amounts of data are leaked, sending the NSA to the Fly Team for assistance, including the Bureau's liaison to the NSA.

13.o: The Fly Team heads to Oslo when they are tipped off that two Norwegian prisoners are being held in Russia.

1.o: The Fly Team meets Supervisory Special Agent Wesley "Wes" Mitchell when his partner is shot in LA and the suspects flee to Budapest, sending Mitchell overseas.

2.o: When a U.S. ambassador is taken hostage at a TV station in the Netherlands alongside 70 civilians, the Fly Team is forced to work quickly to find out who they're up against. Meanwhile, Wes works to earn the respect of his new team.

3.o: When an American teenager disappears from a beach party during her senior year trip to Portugal, the Fly Team heads up the search, which is further complicated by the missing teen's parents' differing opinions.

4.o: The deputy inspector general calls on Tate, who is fluent in Spanish, to take on her first undercover field mission, joining Wes and the team in Spain as they investigate a seemingly dirty U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration special agent working out of Madrid.

5.o: When an American man is kidnapped in Warsaw alongside a Ukrainian woman he met on a dating site, the Fly Team heads to Poland to track down the mastermind behind the site.

6.o: When a bus full of American volunteers is hijacked in a dangerous section of Morocco, the Fly Team works to locate the missing aid workers and the people who kidnapped them.

7.o: Wes' former colleague, U.S.-based agent Tyler Booth, enlists the Fly Team's assistance in helping him capture an American on the FBI's "Most Wanted" list by luring him out of Russia with the help of the perp's conflicted ex-wife.

8.o: When the star witness in the case against Greg Csonka, the man responsible for the death of Wes' former partner, is beaten to death in a Budapest prison before he can testify, the Fly Team attempts to salvage the case to secure Csonka's conviction.

9.o: A member of the Fly Team goes missing as the hunt for Greg Csonka continues in Paris. Meanwhile, Vo’s life hangs in the balance after being shot.

10.t: Keep Calm and Deliver the Biotoxin
10.o: When a Russian biochemist is assassinated for trying to defect with his highly sensitive biotoxins research, the Fly Team springs into action to protect his daughter, whose father’s last wish was that she get his research to a trusted American microbiologist. Meanwhile, Mitchell stays behind to help Vo during her recovery, and Booth clashes with Smitty when he finds out she could jeopardize his promotion.

11.o: When an American student is found dead at a prestigious UK university, the Fly Team investigates an infamous secret society. Smitty’s personal history with the school comes to a head when she’s confronted with the same old-world elitism.

12.o: The Fly Team leads an international manhunt when an American woman and her new husband flee from Baltimore to Istanbul with her young son after a heinous murder. Also, Vo partners up with Special Agent Riley Quinn, who was not only sent to Budapest to work her first big case alongside The Fly Team but to also clandestinely investigate a member of the team.

13.o: When an American businessman is gunned down in Bratislava, the Fly Team must work with an unscrupulous local detective while safeguarding the sole witness, a fearful tourist from Wisconsin being held by police. Meanwhile, Quinn begins to feel pressure from her brother to deliver information on Mitchell.

14.o: After a young American woman is brutally murdered in Venice, the Fly Team is met with hostility when they discover that their person of interest has ties to a well-connected Italian family. Soon, the case gets even more complicated when the CIA Station Chief shows up with an agenda of his own. Meanwhile, pressure mounts on Quinn to deliver intel on Mitchell.

15.o: When a televangelist on the FBI’s most wanted list surfaces in Gibraltar to seek asylum, the Fly Team’s attempts to take him down hit a roadblock as they face political stonewalling upon arrival to the region. When the predatory preacher goes after the daughter of a disciple as his next target, the team must abandon protocol to intervene.

16.o: After an American CEO living in Prague is extorted for millions in cryptocurrency and his family is kidnapped, Mitchell receives a surprise visit from his ex-girlfriend, FBI Special Agent Ella Driscoll, who wants the Fly Team’s help on the case.

17.o: When a psychologist with national security intel goes missing on a hike in the Swiss Alps, the Fly Team works alongside a friendly face, Agent Tyler Booth, to find him. Meanwhile, Mitchell receives unnerving news regarding his biological father.

18.o: The Fly Team heads to the country of Georgia to determine the motive behind an attack that targeted two American soldiers at a NATO-Georgia joint training center before it turns into an international incident. Meanwhile, a supervisory position opens in another FBI division in Europe, and Mitchell encourages both Vo and Raines to apply.

19.o: When a suspected American arms dealer with a lengthy rap sheet pops up in Vienna with stolen weapons, the Fly Team sends Mitchell and Smitty undercover to try to infiltrate his operation. During the mission, Smitty enters muddy waters while working with the suspect’s wife. Meanwhile, Mitchell’s biological father shows up in Budapest after being released from prison to seek him out despite Mitchell’s disinterest.

20.o: When an American official in charge of a high-profile three-way prisoner swap in Belgrade is detained in Romania, he requests the Fly Team step in and carry out the exchange. When their convoy is attacked and one of the prisoners escapes, the team must do everything in their power to find the missing prisoner before the highly sensitive mission is compromised.

21.o: When an American student and sex worker is murdered in Budapest, similarities to a recent case in Japan lead the Fly Team to partner with detectives from Tokyo.

22.o: The Fly Team discovers they’re on the trail of a serial killer, taking the investigation, and Mitchell, to Japan to put an end to the international killing spree.

3.o: تُحدث "إن كيونغ" جلبة في حفل بمناسبة فوز "هيو رين بارك" في مسابقة، وتتوجّه "إن جو" إلى مستشفًى للأمراض العقلية لأجل توصيل زهرة الأوركيد وطلب النصيحة.

4.o: في حديقة سرّية، تطلب "سانغ إيه وون" من "إن هي أوه" رسم لوحة لها، وتتجادل "إن جو" و"إن كيونغ" حول مصير الأموال التي عُثر عليها.

5.o: تبدأ كلّ من "إن جو" و"إن كيونغ" وظيفة جديدة وتدقّقان النظر في أسئلة ليست لها إجابات، بينما تذهب "سانغ إيه" في رحلة على حين غرّة، ممّا يتسبب في ردّ فعل مفاجئ.

6.o: تتجادل "إن جو" و"إن هي" حول ما عليهما فعله بشأن دليل صادم قد عثرتا عليه. أمّا "إن كيونغ"، فتصارع مع عواقب ضجّة إعلامية كبيرة.

7.o: تأثرًا بالأحداث الأخيرة، يتعيّن على الشقيقتين التمعّن أكثر في الماضي أملًا في اكتشاف الحقيقة. وتكشف "إن كيونغ" عن سرّ، وتدبّر "إن جو" خطّة.

8.o: تسافر "إن جو" إلى الخارج وتتلقّى ترحيبًا غير متوقّع، وهو أمر يطرح المزيد من الأسئلة. وتحاول "إن هي" و"هيو رين" مساعدة "سانغ آه" التي تعيش في عزلة.

9.o: تتعرّض "إن جو" لخطر داهم عقب لقاء زائر غامض في الخارج، وتقترح "إن كيونغ" عقد اتفاق لإنقاذ شقيقتها الكبرى.

10.o: يواجه "جاي سانغ بارك" تهديدًا. ومع بعض المساعدة، تنطلق "إن هي" و"هيو رين" للبدء من جديد، وتعثر "إن كيونغ" على طريقتها الخاصة لكشف الحقيقة.

11.o: يُقدم "جاي سانغ" على خطوة جذرية. وفي أعقاب ذلك، تواجه الشقيقات غضب خصوم مألوفين اكتسبوا الجرأة حديثًا بحصولهم على قوّة ونفوذ كبيرين.

12.o: أثناء جلسة استماع إحدى الشقيقات، يثير ظهورٌ مفاجئ ضجّة في قاعة المحكمة، وتحتدم المشاعر عندما تتمّ أخيرًا الإجابة عن بعض الأسئلة العالقة.

1.o: آسيا وإرتان، اللذان فقدا إيمانهما بالحياة والبشر منذ زمن، يُكافحان للبقاء في هذه اللعبة التي صنعاها، ويخلقان مأزقهما الخاص دون علمهما. فهل سينتصر آسيا وإرتان، الطموحان لدرجة أنهما لا يترددان في خيانة الآخرين لمصلحتهما الشخصية، أم تبتلعهما اللعبة بالكامل؟

2.o: هيدايت عازم على تعريف أبنائه بآسيا. هذا اللقاء حافل بأسرار جديدة وأحداث مهمة. بعد أن اكتشف أشقاء باكيزاده خطة والدهم، لا ينوون الاستسلام. فهل ستكون خطوة كوراي نهاية إرتان وآسيا واللعبة التي دبروها؟

3.o: Asya, who doesn't trust Ertan at all, decides to fend for herself. She needs to find the money quickly to pay off her debt to the loan shark Eyüp. To do this, she secretly begins searching for alternative ways to get the money. Ertan, in his quest to find his mother and recognize the father who abandoned him, has managed to become the Bakizade family's lawyer. However, Kadir, whom he believes to be his father, is not only the family's lawyer but also their accomplice. Ertan is devastated when he learns this. Furthermore, he is pressured by Hidayet to finish the job Kadir started. Enraged by Hi

4.o: يُوقع إرتان وآسيا في فوضى عارمة بسبب نتيجة الحمض النووي غير المتوقعة، ويُجبران على اكتشاف من غيّرها. وبينما يرضى هدايت بالنتيجة، تندلع حربٌ داخل عائلته. تلجأ آسيا، المحاصرة بتهديدات أيوب، إلى إرتان، بينما يُضطر إرتان، تحت ضغط هدايت، إلى اتخاذ قرارٍ حاسم. يخرج مخططهما عن السيطرة، وينجرّ كلاهما إلى طريقٍ مسدود.

5.o: دعوى إثبات نسب هدايت، وصورة طه في يد أيوب التي ستؤدي إلى مقتل كورشات، وحب إيمير الأسير والمستبد، وفأس المعركة الذي يشهره الأخوان باكي زاده عليهما... في مواجهة كل هذا، تقف آسيا وإرتان جنبًا إلى جنب ولا تثقان ببعضهما البعض أبدًا...

6.o: بينما يُجبرهم هداية على التعاون تحت سقف واحد، يُكافح إرتان وآسيا في اللعبة التي ابتكروها، فلا خيار أمامهما سوى تعلم الثقة. تُعقّد المشاعر المتنامية بينهما الأمور أكثر، وكلٌّ منهما مُصمّم على كشف أسرار الآخر. في هذه الأثناء، يلعب هداية مع عائلته، وتغوص شيملا في المجهول على درب طه. بينما تُجرّ آسيا إلى الزواج من إيمير، تطلب المساعدة، لكن القدر لا يُرسل لها عونًا، بل اختبارًا قاسيًا.

7.o: بينما تبحث آسيا عن مخرج من قبضة القدر، تُصدم إرتان بضربات مفاجئة، ويصبح من المستحيل إخفاء مشاعرهما المتنامية. بينما يواجه هدايت خيانةً جسيمة ويضع خططًا جديدة ستؤثر على الجميع، ينطلق أيوب، معتقدًا أن آسيا قد خدعته، فيسلك طريقًا خطيرًا للانتقام. يندلع هذا التهديد المتزايد في حريقٍ هائل يلتهم حياة آسيا، وسلام الحي، وإرتان نفسه. ليس من المؤكد ما إذا كان إرتان قادرًا على انتشال آسيا وأحبائه من هذا الفخ.

8.o: Asya and Ertan fight to save Taha from Eyüp’s deadly scheme as events spiral out of control. While Asya’s family confronts the past, Hidayet and Eymir reach the breaking point in their own battles. Amid the chaos, Asya and Ertan’s revealed love faces its greatest test, with a deadly threat closing in.

9.o: Asya and Ertan’s marriage shatters the balance within the Bakizade mansion, while Hidayet’s self-sacrifice leaves behind unsettling questions. As Hidayet is hospitalized, a power struggle erupts among the siblings, forcing them to decide whether they can unite against Ertan. While Ertan searches for Eymir with Eyüp’s unexpected support, everyone pursues their own agenda—until Hidayet’s next move rewrites the rules of the game.

10.o: Hidayet’s decision to hand over his authority to Ertan pushes the Bakizade siblings into openly turning against Ertan and Asya, while the couple remains determined to shoulder this burden together. As the siblings form dangerous alliances to discredit Ertan, Eyüp’s unexpected arrival further escalates tensions. While Ertan fights to protect Asya, newly revealed truths and a carefully laid trap begin dragging them toward a far darker end than they ever anticipated.

11.o: While the Bakizade siblings believe Ertan’s arrest has freed them from him, Asya races to prove his innocence. At the same time, a chain poisoning scandal shakes the Bakizade brand, leading Ertan and Asya to realize they are facing a carefully planned conspiracy. As this crisis threatens to reunite divided siblings, the dangerous closeness between Eymir and Feray, Taha’s decision to leave Simla, and İrem’s desperate fight for Samet push everyone toward an irreversible path.

12.o: Ertan is shaken by a new lead about Kadir’s death just as he begins forming an unexpected bond with his siblings. While he and Asya follow the trail, Simla’s discovery puts Asya at serious risk within the family. As hidden truths surface and loyalties shift, the game Asya and Ertan built reaches its final act—pushing them onto a path with no turning back.

13.o: As Ertan faces the irreversible truth about his father's death, a confrontation with Koray pushes him to the edge. While Asya struggles to keep her siblings together, the Bakizade family is rocked by a sudden crime and Hidayet facing mortal danger. Secret alliances crumble, leading to an inevitable final showdown for Asya and Ertan.

14.o: The events of a single night leave lasting fractures in everyone’s lives, as Asya faces her greatest loss and her grief turns into a desire for reckoning. While Ertan struggles to piece together a night he cannot remember, he becomes the prime suspect in two murders. As Hidayet attempts to restore a collapsing order, fragile balances are shaken, and Asya and Ertan move closer to a truth that comes at an inevitable cost.

15.t: No Love Is Real Unless It Is Tested
15.o: After the night Koray and İrem are killed, the unanswered gaps leave everyone facing unsettling questions. Asya puts her grief aside to follow her suspicions, only to confront an unexpected truth with Ertan. While Ertan struggles with terrifying gaps in his memory, Taha’s loss of control signals the beginning of a dangerous turn for all.

16.o: بينما تسير خطة أيوب بإحكام، يجد إرتان نفسه في قلب النظام الجديد داخل قصر باكيزادِه. ومع فرض الإقامة الجبرية، تحاول آسيا البقاء إلى جانبه، وفي الوقت نفسه تواصل بحثها عن شقيقها وسط تصاعد التوتر. انكشاف الأسرار، وتحديد المواقف، والمخططات التي تُحاك في الخفاء، كلها تغيّر موازين القوة داخل القصر بشكل لا رجعة فيه.

17.t: Put the Kettle On, We’re Starting Again
17.o: بعد تحرّر إرتان من القيود، ينطلق مع آسيا وراء خيوط جديدة لينتقل التحرك إلى الميدان. مبادرة آسيا الجريئة تضع الخطة في خطر، فيما يشدّد هدايت سيطرته داخل القصر وتُرسَم الجبهات بوضوح. ومع تحوّل اتصال سري إلى تهديد حقيقي، يبدأ الوقت بالنفاد أمام إرتان.

18.o: تُشعل المواجهة التي تقع في الفندق التوتر بين إرتان وآسيا وإبراهيم، فيما تؤدي الاتهامات والارتباطات غير القانونية إلى قلب الموازين. شكوك إرتان تقوده إلى تحقيق خطير يكشف اسماً جديداً قادراً على تغيير مسار اللعبة. وفي قصر باكيزادِه، يتحول شرط هدايت إلى قرار مصيري في صراع القوة.

19.o: Ertan follows his heart and opens a new chapter with Asya. Their bond strengthens and they grow closer. However, the sense of sacrifice brewing inside Asya casts a quiet shadow over their happiness. Her mother pulls her one way, and Asya another but Ertan doesn’t hesitate and chooses love. Yet this choice only adds more weight to Asya’s shoulders. At that moment, İbrahim makes a completely unexpected move. He closes the chapter on the relationship he had become obsessed with, but a closed door opens another wide. Hidayet sits Asya down and urges her to marry İbrahim. Emotions and calculations

20.o: As Ertan and Asya navigate their feelings together, the pressure from Hidayet Bakizade reaches its peak. Asya’s collaboration with İbrahim to find out Ertan’s mother’s whereabouts, though seemingly a search for a solution, marks the beginning of a dangerous path. Their stance against Hidayet sets off a chain reaction that shakes not only their own lives but also the lives of everyone connected to them. Amid mounting pressure and exhausting developments, Ertan’s decision signals that their relationship has entered a point of no return.

21.o: The decision that separates Ertan and Asya's paths causes them to question everything they left behind once more. As the distance between them grows with Asya's divorce request, it begins to emerge that some chapters that seemed closed in the past were never actually closed. Despite everything that happened, the duo continues to work together, realizing they are up against a very large criminal organization and following the leads they find. Meanwhile, an unexpected development that arises before Taha and Simla drags them into a great dilemma. In the same days, a detail noticed by Feray is pow

22.o: As Ertan follows the clues, they lead him to an increasingly darker place, while the developments surrounding the Bakizade Foundation begin to draw attention. Unable to hear from Ertan, Asya pursues her suspicions. Meanwhile, a small detail noticed within the foundation is powerful enough to crack open the door to a truth that has been hidden for a long time. At the end of this story, will the accounts of years finally be settled, allowing the guilty to face their punishment and the good to prevail?

1.o: With a full-time professorship in sight, Seo Ji-yoon, a lecturer in Korean art history, gets swept up in a scandal surrounding a monumental painting.

2.o: Ji-yoon shows what she brought back from Bologna to her friend Hye-jeong, a conservation scientist, who tells her that restoration will take a while.

3.o: Lee Gyeom visits Saimdang's parents to seek permission for marriage. King Jungjong sets out to see for himself the woman who won Gyeom's heart.

4.o: Back at the temple, Saimdang witnesses a scene she shouldn't have seen. On the run, she gets hurt, and her belongings land in the hands of another.

5.o: After sending back the presents from Gyeom, Saimdang sets out for her new home in Hanyang, but an unpleasant surprise awaits her.

6.o: The truth behind Saimdang's words hurts Lord Uiseong. However, inspired by watching Saimdang and her children interact, he picks up his brush again.

7.o: In Hanyang, paths cross for Saimdang, Lord Uiseong, Min Chi-hyeong and Hwieumdang. In the present, Professor Min's underlings are on Ji-yoon's tail.

8.o: Hwieumdang scolds Hyeon-ryong for being on the school grounds again. Lord Uiseong hears about Hyeon-ryong's situation and the Mothers Association.

9.o: To support her family, Saimdang decides to make paper, but it's easier said than done. Hwieumdang suggests a mother-son illustrated poetry contest.

10.o: Saimdang gets worried when Hyeon-ryong doesn't come home late into the night. Lord Uiseong tries to find out what happened at Temple Unpyeong.

11.o: Risking retaliation from the vagabonds, Saimdang goes back to her paper workshop. Later, she tells the head of the group why she decided to come back.

12.o: Lord Uiseong's Great Aunt warns him not to dig up the past lest he endanger his and Saimdang's lives. Saimdang needs a sample of true Goryeo paper.

13.o: Hwieumdang calls for an emergency meeting that Saimdang must attend. Meanwhile, Lord Uiseong suggests a hunting outing for the king and the council.

14.o: The king declares a contest to find the best papermaker in Joseon. Lord Uiseong gets authority to investigate the corruption behind the Goryeo paper.

15.o: Soon after they arrive at the site of Temple Unpyeong, Saimdang and Pal-bong are pursued by Hwieumdang's men.

16.o: King Jungjong decides on the proper punishment for Min Chi-hyeong. Meanwhile, the deadline to find the true Goryeo paper is fast approaching.

17.o: For King Jungjong, nothing else matters except finding the real Goryeo paper. Saimdang presses on to decipher the poem from the painting.

18.o: Ji-yoon tries to get Director Sun's help in ensuring the safety of "Mount Kumgang," but Director Sun wants to avoid getting more bad publicity.

19.o: In the present, Ji-yoon gets an alarming call about her husband. In the past, Lord Uiseong hears of the Yangryu Paper Mill from the villagers he helps.

20.o: Saimdang is becoming a prominent figure in the city for her wisdom, benevolence and artistic skills, but trouble brews at home.

21.o: The princess is reported missing. King Jungjong is furious that the crown prince is spending time outside the palace walls with Lord Uiseong.

22.o: The crown prince commissions Lord Uiseong to paint King Jungjong's portrait. Lord Uiseong wishes to recruit new painters for the important project.

23.o: The Confucian scholars protest against Saimdang, and the king plots to use this to his advantage. Min Chi-hyeong is hell-bent on reclaiming his power.

24.o: Lord Uiseong is shocked to learn what King Jungjong ordered Min Chi-hyeong to do. Meanwhile, Hwieumdang has a tearful request for Saimdang.

25.o: While visiting a museum to collect her thoughts, Ji-yoon discovers a note card with a curious portrait that's left behind by a mysterious man.

26.o: With the help of Rade, Ji-yoon and her friends are devising a plan to secure "Mount Kumgang" again when a surprise visitor drops by their hideout.

27.o: Despairing Saimdang asks Ji-yoon what happened to Lord Uiseong. Piecing the clues together, Ji-yoon provides Saimdang with a way to save Lord Uiseong.

28.o: Director Sun publicly reveals her intentions regarding "Mount Kumgang." Saimdang spends her time with those who matter to her the most.

1.o: After a fight outside a bar, 19-year-old Sonny Conran is arrested and charged with a murder. His mum Jo rushes to Bulgaria, but Sonny's lawyer warns Jo that the police have already made up their minds. Jo focuses on proving Sonny's innocence.

2.o: Left with no choice but to continue Cormac's international drug runs, Jo turns to her ex for help. Following a close call with the police, Jo is forced to quickly secrete heroin in the airport, but it goes missing. She has 24 hours to get it back.

3.o: Jo rushes to Sofia when Sonny is stabbed in prison. Elsewhere, having enlisted the help of his former police partner, Shana, Dom is told that the Met have zero intel on Cormac. Jo returns home to a surprise visitor who delivers some shocking news.

4.o: Dom warns Jo that Cormac is extremely dangerous but she ignores his advice and follows him to a meeting with an unknown boss. A veiled threat makes Mel suspicious and a new witness comes forward in Sonny's defence - although things do not go as expected at the appeal hearing. Jo is told to run - but instead, she and new ally Kayla come up with a new plan.

5.o: After stealing the heroin and money, Jo realises Cormac is also being blackmailed, so they collude to get out for good. Smuggling more heroin, they sell it on, while Cormac puts things in place for Jo's escape. Kayla gives birth, and Shana reveals to Dom that Cormac's boss is Anton Marquis - a senior police officer.

6.o: Jo demands answers and finally uncovers the truth in Sonny's case. She and Cormac execute their escape plan, though she remains uneasy as to whether he can be trusted.

1.o: Molly Phillips' new gig in Chicago is in an old waterfront building that turns out to be haunted by the ghost of a drowned boy. Her daughter, Fiona (Fi), who seems to always investigate the paranormal, becomes curious when the drowned boy keeps appearing to her.

2.o: Fi receives unknown emails predicting the future and she believes they're from her dead father.

3.o: Enroute to Tulsa, Fi and the gang visit a town in Oklahoma where it seems that aliens have repressed the memories of everyone in the entire town after their ship crash landed the previous night.

4.o: While lost in the woods, Fi helps a Bigfoot-like creature remain undetected by humans at the risk of her own life.

5.o: Fi discovers that a girl is astroprojecting herself to escape the problems in her life.

6.o: Fi and the gang stay in a small town where mischievious gremlins break everything that's mechanical.

7.o: The apparition of a man runs the tour bus off the road and Fi believes he's death himself. But he's really an angel come to tell Fi that she's a bone marrow match for Jack's new friend Gabe.

8.o: While visiting her aunt and twin cousins, Fi inadvertently conjures up a creature using a Celtic spell and learns of her family's history with Celtic magic.

9.o: When Molly meets up with her old time friend, Rebecca 's daughter, Fi dicovers a mysterious secret.The girl is actually the Rebecca from Molly's past and is immortal which is the reason why she mysteriously dissapeared many years ago.

10.o: Fi meets a 9 year old boy who's created a troublesome entity (or tulpa) by concentrated thought and this entity is very dangerous.

11.o: Clu becomes lost in a wormhole at the playground and it's up to Fi to save him.

12.o: Fi uses the computer game SimCity to help a comatose woman wake up from her own mind where she's been trapped since she was a child.

6.o: Clu finds a piece of driftwood that has causes Ned to exhibit signs of being possessed by a captain of a ship that sank a long time ago.

7.o: A Halloween gig in a strange New England town called Rhiannon turns into a nightmare when Fi discovers that the spirits of the dead walk the night on Halloween and drag any living beings back with them.

8.o: While at a bed and breakfast, Fi suspects that the animal preying on local farms may be a werewolf.

9.o: Fi meets a young man who's really the clone of his genius scientist father.

10.o: When a rich but nerdy computer genius is attracted to Molly, Fi gets the opportunity to examine a mysterious out of place artifact that turns out to be an ancient computing device.

11.o: Fi fears that a banshee has come to announce the impending death of her grandfather.

12.o: As Molly shoots a music video in an abandoned building, Fi discovers a portal to the spirit world and can't resist entering it.

13.o: On Christmas Eve, a magic soda fountain sends Fi back in time for an important lesson. She gets to see her father again and learns about something she never knew.

14.o: Ned's childhood friend, Sam gets caught up in the reenactment of a tragic childhood accident where Ned and Sam watched their best friend die.

15.o: The Will o' the Wisp that once possessed Jack, returns and this time jumps into Molly and once again plays with Fi's mind and reveals a secret to her.

16.o: A haunting blues song provides clues to a past murder that Fi is determined to uncover.

17.o: Molly, Jack and Carey find themselves trapped in a succession of virtual realities by a lonely young man, while Fi tries to figure out where they are.

18.o: Fi discovers that Carey's hospital roommate was revived after being cryogenically frozen in an experiment.

19.o: At a roadside diner, Fi's family and friends disappear one by one, seemingly turning into vegetables and Fi learns the owner of the diner is really a troll.

20.o: Jack is very suspicious of his mother's new love interest and well he should be since the man is really a merman.

21.o: Fi meets a homeless man who turns out to be in possession of an artifact from the 1947 Roswell UFO crash.

22.o: Jack discovers that the OSSN, an online student support network is actually a front for something sinister. But what he doesn't know is that all the members are actually vampires and he unwittingly manages to save his family, friends and himself with his angel necklace that seems to ward off the creatures.

23.o: When Fi tries to expose abuse at an animal shelter, a witch turns her into a dog.

24.o: Flooded by memories of Rick and all the strange things that have happened while on the road, Molly decides to end the tour and go home, much to Fi's dismay.

25.o: Fi investigates an old family friend, John, a former guitar player who's lost the ability to play after receiving a heart transplant, and is showing signs of madness.

26.o: Fi believes her dead father is trying to communicate from beyond the grave through his twin sister.
